## Description

A clear and concise description of what this pull request changes or implements.

## Motivation & Context

- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve?
- Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Visual / Design system change (tokens, materials, themes)
- [ ] Code refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Quality & Compatibility Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards and AGENTS.md rules.
- [ ] I have not used modern JavaScript APIs that break Chromium 53.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with 0 errors (Stylelint and ESLint).
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with 0 errors.
- [ ] `npm test` passes all unit and integration tests.
- [ ] For bug fixes: I have added a regression test that fails without this fix.
- [ ] I have NOT included real stream URLs, credentials, or proprietary tokens in code, tests, or documentation (synthetic identifiers only).
- [ ] The remote control focus invariant is maintained (only the surface with key ownership paints a ring).
